publisher: Vermont Department for Children and Families, Child Development Division
ownership: Official Vermont Child Care Provider Data ctdw-tmfz, restricted to Licensed Provider CBCCPP and CBCCPP - Non-Recurring rows.
allowed_use: internal immutable retention, verification, reconciliation and offline normalization
prohibited_use: contact, person-ID, mailing-only, coordinate or cached-sample fields
inferring an exact reporting date from the filename
claiming listing membership independently verifies current operation, premises or unique business identity
record-level public or combined-database export under this profile
attribution: Vermont DCF Child Development Division; data.vermont.gov; Open Database License 1.0 notice retained.
retention: Preserve immutable verified selected acquisitions, policy evidence, derived releases and explicit gaps for offline reuse.
redistribution: Internal source-separated use only. Public or combined export requires separate ODbL notice, share-alike and access governance.
personal_data_handling: Exclude family homes, contacts, person identifiers and jittered coordinate values before retention; do not enrich people.
authorization_basis: User-authorized official US business-source collection and reviewed ODbL designation; no account, credential, fee or agreement acceptance.
semantic_boundary: file_name plus license_id is release-scoped source identity. Monthly center-cohort membership is temporal source evidence, not independent current-operation proof. Reporting period and address role remain unresolved; ZIP5 and ZIP4 stay separate; private/non-ZCTA and missing geography remain explicit.
